# Identical
<center>
![](/images/identikeys.png){style="width:200px; background: white; border-radius:5px; border: white solid 5px"}
</center>

I touched on the `identical()` <u id='function_tooltip'>__function__</u> previously to compare two resulting <u id='data_frame_tooltip'>__data frames__</u>. 
`identical()` will compare two objects and if the objects are exactly identical it will print TRUE. 
If they are not exactly identical it will print FALSE. 
The <u id='function_tooltip'>function</u> can be given __scalars__, __vectors__, __data frames__ etc. 

Try out the below examples.
```{r eval=FALSE}
identical(1,1)
identical(1,2)
identical("word","word")
identical("word","orb")
identical(1,"1")
identical("one",1)
identical(1:5,1:5)
identical(1:5,6:9)
identical(1:5,1:6)
identical(c("a","b"),c("a","b"))
identical(c("a","b"),c("c","b"))
identical(c("a","b"),c("b","a"))
identical(english_df,english_df)
identical(english_df,tea_df)
```
